metadata.note: Live process measurements contain resource counters only; offline probes use synthetic data.
metadata.toolchain: Rust 1.98.0, aarch64-apple-darwin, release profile, default M1 CPU baseline

measurement: Existing macOS processes sampled with proc_pid_rusage v2; CPU Mach ticks converted with mach_timebase_info; 100 percent means one core.
live_protocol: Same selected chat at newest message; visible window raised through accessibility before each 15-second series; no input or compilation during samples. Two consecutive post-update samples; additional focused sample after checking scroll-up/return-to-bottom. No messages sent.
offline_protocol: Fresh release demo processes; three-second settlement then ten-second samples. Three alternating normal-chat pairs plus preliminary empty/normal/10000-message runs. Window visibility was not controlled.
limitations: Short observations of one live chat, not a general workload or battery-life result.
Uncontrolled native demo launches showed inconsistent CPU usage; retain all samples, do not compute a speedup from their medians.
One baseline native scrolling benchmark completed, but the fixed counterpart timed out at 25 seconds; no valid paired native scrolling or startup measurement.

The baseline demo build emitted rust-objcopy stripping warnings because libLLVM.dylib was not found. The fixed build provided DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH and stripped successfully. Both used the same pinned release compiler and CPU baseline.
No GPU timestamps, power measurements, network throughput, cold archive timing or timed chat-switch benchmark.
The live account was retained across local bundle replacement; resource data contains no message contents or contact identifiers.

baseline.note: eframe CPU time includes UI/render submission, excludes vsync wait; no GPU timestamps or energy measurement
baseline.workload: offline chat scrolling up 80 points per frame, 2 seconds warmup then 240 frames, continuous repaint stress

manual_validation: Developer ID signature verified; arm64 only
Installed release opens existing linked account
